newsitem.title: GREECE: Short-end of Greek yield curve firms on ecu/drs.
newsitem.headline: Short-end of Greek yield curve firms on ecu/drs.

text.p: About 60 to 100 million ecus were bought by banks at the fixing pulling ecu/drachma up to 303.740 from Wednesday's 303.160 and giving reason to market players to up short rates by about 20 basis points, dealers said.

"The central bank sold ecus for drachmas to banks driving ecu/drachma higher. The market remains short and the short-end firmed by about 20 basis points on the heels of these outflows," said a foreign bank dealer.
The Bank of Greece injected overnight liquidity at 13.40 percent.

Bond dealers said trading was subdued in the secondary market with U.S markets closed and Greece hit by a 24-hour general strike that the private sector seemed to ignore but the public sector to follow.
The mark was quoted at 157.50/60 drachmas from Thursday's 157.530 fix, the dollar at 241.48/58 drachmas from 241.200 and the Ecu at 303.78/88 from 303.740 drachmas.
